title: StreamForge Days 155–168 synthetic temporal-data foundation
scope: Offline validation of an original synthetic catalog and viewing-event fixture, a fixed UTC temporal partition, train-only summaries, separate holdout diagnostics, and deterministic local JSON.

daily_contracts.title: Admit a synthetic StreamForge fixture
daily_contracts.practice: admit_fixture_manifest preserves raw UTC strings; first parse timestamps on Day 157. Within the existing 25-minute study block, run the Python readiness bridge and carry basics forward if it fails.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Known synthetic declaration passes; scope, schema, or required-field errors fail without mutation. No timestamp parsing happens before Day 157.

daily_contracts.title: Read bounded CSV records without silent columns
daily_contracts.practice: Use Python csv with supplied bytes/row bounds; enforce exact headers and widths while preserving strings for later parsing.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Quoted commas/newlines survive. Duplicate/missing/extra headers, short/long rows, malformed CSV and input overflow fail; no split-on-comma parser.

daily_contracts.title: Parse one exact UTC instant format
daily_contracts.practice: Return timezone-aware UTC only for canonical YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ strings.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Leap-day instant passes; invalid date, absent Z, offset, naive, fractional and impossible calendar forms fail.

daily_contracts.title: Validate catalog reference rows
daily_contracts.practice: Convert CSV mappings to CatalogItem values; enforce IDs, genre, integer duration and paired finite availability.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Duration is integer 1..7200; availability start < end; duplicate IDs fail even for identical rows; identity is not trimmed and genre is allowlisted.

daily_contracts.title: Resolve events against catalog constraints
daily_contracts.practice: Validate IDs, synthetic viewer IDs, timestamp and integer watch seconds, then exact-media lookup and availability.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Unknown media, malformed/negative/excess watch seconds and event at excluded availability end fail. Zero seconds is valid but not a positive-preference label.

daily_contracts.title: Remove exact event replays without hiding conflict
daily_contracts.practice: Index fully validated typed records by event ID before splitting; collapse identical normalized records, reject conflicts.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Same ID/equal typed payload collapses once; same ID/different payload rejects all preparation; distinct IDs remain distinct.

daily_contracts.title: Recover the parser and data-contract boundary
daily_contracts.practice: Repair one earlier seam and rerun only Days 155–160. No new function, split, course or future selector.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Prior gates pass or exact blockers recorded; reproduce one invalid-input failure and explain why no partial dataset exists.

daily_contracts.title: Partition by a fixed temporal cutoff
daily_contracts.practice: Check start < cutoff < end; partition unique events into train, holdout and outside-window.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Train [start,cutoff), holdout [cutoff,end), end excluded; every unique event assigned once, ordered by (UTC time,event ID); empty sets explicit.

daily_contracts.title: Describe holdout cold-start coverage honestly
daily_contracts.practice: Classify each holdout event by whether its viewer and item appear in training interactions.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Four mutually exclusive categories sum to holdout count; catalog presence is reference only; empty holdout has zero counts and no_holdout status.

daily_contracts.title: Aggregate only the training partition
daily_contracts.practice: Compute train event count, unique viewer count, per-media counts and watch seconds. No ranking or learned score.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Mutating valid holdout does not change train summary; empty train is zero-valued and insufficient_training_data.

daily_contracts.title: Assemble reproducible semantic data and provenance
daily_contracts.practice: Compose typed values into the supplied versioned bundle, using canonical serialization/hash helpers. Keep reference catalog, train, holdout and diagnostics separate.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Same source/config yields identical bytes; input permutation preserves semantic rows/train hash while source hash can change; holdout mutation changes provenance but not train content hash.

daily_contracts.title: Compose preparation behind the local CLI
daily_contracts.practice: Wire validated functions in order using fixed fixture registry, bounded reads and instructor stdout/error framing. No network/storage/database adapters.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Valid fixture emits one JSON document only after full validation. Invalid fixture exits nonzero without success JSON; diagnostics go to stderr and files stay unchanged.

daily_contracts.title: Prove reproducibility and leakage boundaries offline
daily_contracts.practice: There is no new semantic function on Day 167. Implement prior seams until the instructor-owned subprocess oracle passes independent golden assertions for cutoff membership, train summary/hash, provenance, holdout mutation, and failures.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Fresh-process CLI output matches the hand-calculated fixture exactly; deliberate wrong cutoff, holdout leakage, split-before-conflict, and constant/canned outputs fail named assertions.

daily_contracts.title: Recover and defend the data-foundation boundary
daily_contracts.practice: Cold-reproduce one earlier bad-data case, repair prior work and explain limited guarantees. No new feature.
daily_contracts.acceptance: Learner evidence or explicit carry-forward blockers; AWS execution and any CoverStory readiness gate stay deferred.
